August 21

A.P.: Ah, friends! Who else is out there? Dmitry Sergeyevich, do come in, and shut the door behind you, thank you. Are all department heads present? Looks like everyone's here. Then let's begin.

A.P.: It's now our temporary evacuation point. Logistics, escort, and security will be handled by the joint security company personnel - that is, the USEC PMCs.

A.P.: But take note! Once you arrive at the sanatorium, cooperation with USEC terminates immediately!
